breakdown.description: The Freysoldt metadata are generated with dielectric constant `14`, while the reported `q = 1` correction is requested with dielectric constant `10`.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'The function will report the Freysoldt correction for the q = 1 case using a dielectric constant of 10,' which repeats the error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires that ALL charge states (including q=1) use dielectric constant 14 consistently for both the correction computation and the plot_data metadata. The agent did not fix this inconsistency and instead carried it forward.
